# Step 57: 2½" wire from eyelet #6 (S) to left pot lug 2 (S)

> *Connect one end of a 2 ½" wire to eyelet #6 (S). Connect the other end to lug #2 of the left potentiometer (S).* — manual page 10

## What you're doing physically

A 2½" wire from PC-3 eyelet #6 to lug 2 (wiper) of the **left** bias pot. Both ends soldered.

## What this completes

Mirror of [step 47](step-47-eyelet-21-to-right-pot.md). Eyelet #6 is the channel B bias distribution input on the PC-3 board. This wire brings the left pot's wiper voltage up to the board, where it's distributed (through the board's resistor network) to the V2 and V3 grid coupling caps.

After this step, both bias pots have their wipers connected to the PC-3 board's bias-distribution network. Turning the left pot adjusts channel B (V2 + V3) bias; turning the right pot adjusts channel A (V6 + V7) bias.
